theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_mlb_univ_monotonicity_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → (∀ y : Euclid P, MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (1 / ρ ^ n) * C.massOn (ball y ρ)) (Ioi 0)) ∧ (∃ Θ : Euclid P → ℝ, (∀ y : Euclid P, HasMassDensity C y (Θ y)) ∧ UpperSemicontinuous Θ) ∧ ∀ y ∈ C.support, ∀ θ : ℝ, HasMassDensity C y θ → 1 ≤ θ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
